column1: # INJURY-REPORT SPOT-CHECK — 44 rows transcribed by hand from the official page on 2026-11-17T22:41Z.
# Source: https://www.nfl.com/injuries/ — page title as read: "Official Latest NFL Injury Report for Players
#   - Week 10 of the 2026 Season"; the week selector on the page ends at "WEEK 10" (no Week 11 tab exists).
# What this file is for. The collector reads this page automatically and keeps a hash-addressed capture of
# every read (data/captures/). A capture that nobody re-reads by eye can be a faithful picture of nothing.
# So four club tables - Commanders, Giants, Patriots, Lions, 44 rows - were transcribed from the live page
# by this session and are diffed cell by cell against the newest retained capture by tools/lab/build_reads.py.
# Every field the capture holds is compared: position, injury text, practice designation, game designation
# and the game label the row is printed under. The mismatch count is published; it is not averaged away.
# Why these four clubs. Two are the still-open Week 10 cards the published tables were built from, and two
# (Lions) are the club whose three game-status cells the review queue says were published blank (VR-08, VR-12).
# The live page prints "Out" for Kerby Joseph, Cade Mays and D.J. Reed, and so does the retained capture -
# the result of that comparison against the published site table is in report.json, not decided here.
